turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Ms. Hale. Mr. Hale. I have until 4:40.

Where is my son's zero coming from, and who decided it?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.

I'm not here for thanks. I'm here because Owen found out about this from his phone, in the middle of class.

You entered the zero on the third. When did anyone call me?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student.

So what else do you have, Hale, or is that all of it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Okay.

Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and found neither accurate nor reliable. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software doesn't establish a concern by itself.

So I'll ask again. What else do you have?
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." Okay.

Procedure 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and 4.1 says you speak to Owen first. Which of those did you do?
I hope you understand my position.

I'm not here to understand your position, Hale. I'm here about my son's mark.

I asked you a question about 4.1 and 4.2. Answer it.
